name: notch-notify
description: Flashes your MacBook keyboard and pops an alert out of the notch when Claude Code finishes a reply or needs you.

done_message.title: Done message
done_message.description: Text shown in the notch when Claude finishes a reply

needs_you_message.title: Needs-you message
needs_you_message.description: Text shown in the notch when Claude is waiting for you

backlight_flashes.title: Keyboard backlight flashes
backlight_flashes.description: How many times the keyboard backlight flashes when Claude finishes (0 to turn off)

caps_flashes.title: Caps lock light flashes
caps_flashes.description: How many times the green caps lock light flashes when Claude finishes (0 to turn off)

popup_seconds.title: Pop-up seconds
popup_seconds.description: How long the notch pop-up stays open

show_popup.title: Show notch pop-up
show_popup.description: Turn off to only flash the keyboard

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: macOS sound to play with each alert
